title: board changed
description: Something the board draws moved: a file of the design, the definitions that feed it, or the machine config, so a board reads the design again. Sent while live events are on, from the revision's own fingerprint of the part (card 5f31 in e-designer).

source.description: /designer/<project>: the event comes from e-designer and names the project it serves, so a reader listening to many products and projects knows where the change is (ADR-E2, ADR-S08).

subject.description: The id of the design whose part moved, so a board acts only when it shows that design.

data.description: The part that moved and its fingerprint now.

part.description: Always board, the part this event names.
